title: AI Automation with n8n
description: An introductory guide to automating AI workflows using the open‑source platform n8n, covering key concepts, setup steps, and practical examples.
thumbnailPrompt: A sleek, minimalist design featuring a stylized flowchart in calming blue tones with the text "AI Automation with n8n" overlayed in modern sans‑serif font.

scenes.title: What is n8n?
scenes.imagePrompt: Illustration of a node-based workflow editor on a laptop screen, surrounded by subtle blue gradients.

audio.text: n8n is an open‑source workflow automation tool that enables you to create complex processes without writing code.

scenes.title: Why Combine AI with n8n?
scenes.imagePrompt: A diagram showing an AI model node connected to various data sources, all linked within a single workflow.

audio.text: Integrating AI models into n8n workflows allows you to automate tasks such as natural language processing, image recognition, and predictive analytics at scale.

scenes.title: Setting Up Your First Workflow
scenes.imagePrompt: Step‑by‑step screenshot sequence of creating a new workflow, adding a trigger node and an AI function node.

audio.text: Begin by installing n8n locally or using the cloud version. Create a new workflow, add a trigger such as Webhook, then insert an AI node that calls an external model via HTTP request.

scenes.title: Handling Data and Errors
scenes.imagePrompt: A flowchart illustrating data routing, conditional branches, and error handling within n8n.

audio.text: Use n8n’s built‑in Error Trigger to capture failures, and employ Set or Function nodes to format the data before passing it to downstream AI services.

scenes.title: Scaling and Deployment
scenes.imagePrompt: Server rack illustration with n8n running in Docker containers, connected to cloud AI services.

audio.text: For production use, deploy n8n behind a reverse proxy, enable persistence, and orchestrate multiple instances using Docker Compose or Kubernetes for high availability.
